property.description: AccessControl functions change state as expected.

rules.name: access_control_constructor_integrity
rules.description: after call to constructor the admin is set

rules.name: grant_role_integrity
rules.description: after call to grant_role the account has the role

rules.name: revoke_role_integrity
rules.description: after call to revoke_role the account does not have the role

rules.name: renounce_role_integrity
rules.description: after call to renounce_role the account does not have the role

rules.name: transfer_admin_role_integrity
rules.description: after call to transfer_admin_role with live_until_ledger > current_ledger the pending admin is set to the new admin

rules.name: remove_transfer_admin_role_integrity
rules.description: after call to accept_admin_transfer with live_until_ledger = 0 the pending admin is none

rules.name: accept_admin_transfer_integrity
rules.description: after call to accept_admin_transfer the admin is set to the previous pending admin, which is not none, and the pending admin is set to none

rules.name: set_role_admin_integrity
rules.description: after call to set_role_admin the role admin of the given role is the given admin_role

rules.name: renounce_admin_integrity
rules.description: after call to renounce_admin the admin is none
